posts.title: The Switch to AgileOtter.Dev
posts.description: I feel that this site has run its course. I've taken the time to transfer all of the articles from this blog site to the new one, AgileOtter.Dev . The new site is active and online, and I will be posting all future articles to AgileOtter.Dev. I'll leave this one online for some time so people can find the new one from here.

posts.title: Speculating on Challenges of Spec-Driven Development
posts.description: I'm not fully vested in and convinced by Spec Driven Development. I've gotten over 70% of my initial "BDUF" concern and am thinking more clearly. I thought that it would be a good time for me to list the concerns I have for ongoing SDD. posts.title: Why redesign doesn't happen (enough)
posts.description: Code degrades because it is strongly anchored to the past. Instead of updating, refactoring, reorganising, and rearchitecting the code as we learn over the years, a system tends to keep its original shape, as developers shoehorn new features in with If/else statements.
